name: Question 9
problem:
The position vector $r$ of a particle $P$ (relative to a fixed origin $O$) at time $t$ is given by

$$
r=⟨-\operatorname{cos}⁡t,\operatorname{sin}⁡t⟩,\,t>0.
$$

Calculate the velocity vector $v$ at time $t=\frac{\pi }{2}.$

Question 9
?

The position vector r of a particle P (relative to a fixed origin O) at time t is given by r=⟨−cos⁡t,sin⁡t⟩,t>0. Calculate the velocity vector v at time t=π2.

a
v(π2)=⟨1,0⟩
b
v(π2)=⟨−1,0⟩
c
v(π2)=⟨1,−1⟩
d
v(π2)=⟨−1,1⟩
e
v(π2)=⟨0,1⟩
Submit
